description:
Move a gated issue to done when `jit gate evaluate` passes its last gate, or stop saying it will.

## Background

`jit issue update <id> --state done` on an issue with unpassed gates moves it to `gated` and prints "Issue automatically transitioned to 'gated' and will move to 'done' when all gates pass." (`crates/jit/src/errors.rs:918`). d2b7d19b stayed `gated` after `jit gate evaluate` passed its `cargo-ci` (2026-11-01T09:51:45Z) and then `code-review` (09:55:15Z) with `all_passed` true, and moved only on a further `jit issue update --state done`. `auto_transition_to_done` runs from `gate.rs:881` and `gate_check.rs:1560`, and the evaluate path did not reach it in this case. Found under c780514e.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: After `jit gate evaluate` passes the last unpassed gate of a gated issue, the issue is done and dependents promote, through the existing `auto_transition_to_done`.
- [hard] REQ-02: A failed gate, or an evaluate on an issue that isn't gated, leaves the state unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: All sites that advance after a gate pass share one path. Remove `run_postchecks` if its only remaining reachability is the library-only `State::Gated` branch at `issue.rs:687`, or state in the issue why it stays. Report net lines.
- [hard] REQ-04: Sweep `.jit/`, `contrib/`, skills and docs for steps that follow evaluate with `jit issue update --state done`. Those steps must not fail on an issue already done; remove them where now redundant.
title: Passing a gated issue's last gate through evaluate moves it to done
